axes.xDefinition: log10 halo mass (AHF spherical overdensity, Bryan & Norman virial)
axes.yDefinition: log10 stellar-to-halo mass ratio, M*/Mhalo, from log M* = alpha (log Mhalo - 10) + beta

representation.equation: log10(M*/Mhalo) = alpha (log Mhalo - 10) + beta - log Mhalo

selection.population: central galaxies, all halo snapshots at z=5-12
selection.warning: Power-law fit of Ma et al. 2018 (eq. smhm) to the median M*-Mhalo relation of all halo snapshots at z=5-12, valid for 10^7.5 < Mhalo < 10^12 Msun; the paper finds no significant evolution over this range and the median at a given redshift deviates by at most 0.1 dex. Dispersion in log M*: sigma = exp[-0.14 (log Mhalo - 10) + (-1.1)]. One relation for the whole redshift range, so the epoch is the interval z=5-12.
